description: The Nutmeg Vale Trail is an easy, leisurely 20 min walk through the scenic Covigne Valley in Chaguaramas. The trail winds through lush tropical vegetaion and historic nutmeg groves. It offers visitors a peaceful opportunity to experience the natural beauty and tranquil atmosphere of the valley. Listed opening hours: 24 HOURS. Verify access, opening times and any fees with the site before travelling.
